Wave.name: LocalFirstCriticalPath
Wave.goal: Move the ru/en critical path to a local-first path for STT, translation, and audio response while preserving the existing dual-pipeline behavior.

ExecutionOrder.step-1: W2-C1 persistent local STT worker first, because local-first execution cannot exist until per-request Whisper fallback is replaced.
ExecutionOrder.step-2: W2-C2 local translation provider second, because the local critical path needs both STT and translation before path separation can be validated.
ExecutionOrder.step-3: W2-C3 fast-path versus quality-path separation third, because it depends on the local STT and local MT path already existing.
ExecutionOrder.step-4: W2-C4 preset support last, because UI and saved-config exposure should be built on top of the verified runtime path rather than before it.

Change.summary: Replace per-request Whisper subprocess execution with a persistent local STT worker.

write-scope.file: worker runtime file to be introduced during implementation

implementation-tasks.task-1: Remove the temp WAV roundtrip and per-utterance `pythonw.exe` launch from the local STT path.
implementation-tasks.task-2: Introduce a long-lived local STT worker process or runtime that keeps the model loaded across utterances.
implementation-tasks.task-3: Adapt the Rust STT integration so local STT can act as a primary provider, not only as a terminal fallback.

verification-step.runtime-check: Run the ru/en path with local STT selected and confirm transcript events are produced without Deepgram connectivity.

done-when.item: The local STT hot path no longer writes temp WAV files for each utterance.
The local STT hot path no longer launches `pythonw.exe` once per utterance.
Transcript generation works with no Deepgram dependency on the active path.

stop-if.item: Persistent worker behavior requires a contract-level change to transcript semantics.
Local STT startup or shutdown breaks the pipeline lifecycle in both directions.

Change.summary: Integrate the existing CTranslate2 wrapper as a first-class local translation provider.

implementation-tasks.task-1: Wire the existing local translation wrapper into `TranslationEngine` as a selectable provider for `ru<->en`.
implementation-tasks.task-2: Ensure local translation model loading is compatible with engine startup and runtime configuration.
implementation-tasks.task-3: Add clear provider attribution so accepted translations can be identified as `local_mt` in runtime logs.

verification-step.runtime-check: Run local-only ru/en translation and verify translation events occur without Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex on the hot path.

done-when.item: `ru<->en` translation succeeds through the local provider.
Short-phrase translation variance is lower than the cloud fallback baseline.

stop-if.item: Local translation requires hidden cloud fallback to stay functional.
Model integration destabilizes startup of both pipelines.

Change.summary: Separate the fast local audio path from optional cloud-based correction or quality paths.

implementation-tasks.task-1: Make the fast local path authoritative for transcript-to-audio flow.
implementation-tasks.task-2: Prevent cloud correction or quality work from blocking playback on the local path.
implementation-tasks.task-3: Extend runtime event handling so live translation and revised translation can coexist without UI ambiguity.

verification-step.runtime-check: Verify that audio output still occurs when cloud correction is unavailable or disabled.

done-when.item: Audio output is produced from the local fast path without waiting for cloud correction.
Pipeline state can represent live and revised translation independently.

stop-if.item: Separation breaks the current event contract for transcript or translation delivery.
Playback becomes dependent on optional correction logic.

Change.summary: Add configuration and UI support for a Russia-oriented local-first preset.

implementation-tasks.task-1: Define a preset that selects local STT, local MT, and aggressive realtime thresholds.
implementation-tasks.task-2: Persist preset selection through the existing settings flow.
implementation-tasks.task-3: Expose the preset clearly in the UI without hiding advanced controls.

verification-step.runtime-check: Change to the preset through the UI or settings path, restart the engine, and verify the expected local-first configuration is active.

done-when.item: A single preset enables the local-first ru/en path.
Preset selection survives restart through saved settings.

acceptance-targets.item: ru/en hot path uses `local_mt` instead of Groq, LiteLLM, or Yandex.
Short-phrase translation variance is lower than the cloud fallback baseline.
p50 total latency approaches the local-path target without requiring external API availability.
